name: Grok Bot
notes: Always-on personal agent from xAI with its own computer, email and phone; runs inside X/Grok and via Cursor subscription.

name: Meta Muse
notes: Meta's personal agent, launched 2026-09-08. Exclude invite/referral-code posts (e.g. code 4X23B6, '1 billion tokens').

name: OpenAI Dots
notes: Always-on ChatGPT agents with their own cloud computer. Not to be confused with 'Dotz'.

name: Claude Duet
notes: Anthropic's proactive agent on Opus 5.5 (research preview from ~2026-10-21, US Pro/Max waitlist); morning brief, asks before sending/paying.

name: Manus Cue
notes: 'Manus Q' in the request is phonetically Manus Cue: launched with Manus 2.0 (~2026-09-28), invite-only; each agent gets its own email, phone number, wallet and computer. Many invite-code spam posts.

name: Today AI
notes: Chinese personal AI assistant founded March 2026 by 齐俊元 (Teambition founder, ex-Doubao PC lead); domestic launch Sept 2026; >$200M raise Oct 2026; connects WeChat/Feishu/DingTalk. Lots of signup-promo spam.

name: LingGuang
notes: Ant Group's AI assistant; LingGuang 2.0 (~2026-10-27) integrates Alipay, DingTalk, Feishu, email, Mi Home.

name: Gemini Spark
notes: Google's always-on Gemini agent (since May 2026), later folded into 'Tasks' in the Gemini app.

name: Instinct
notes: Invite-only personal agent used over iMessage/WhatsApp/SMS; supports group chats.

name: Hark
notes: Personal agent from Hark Labs (Brett Adcock).

name: OpenClaw
notes: Open-source self-hosted personal agent; the earliest of this wave; many forks (NanoClaw, MaxClaw, Kimi Claw).

name: Hermes Agent
notes: Open-source self-hosted agent framework from Nous Research; also the base of Tencent LightVela.

name: Qwen Go
notes: Personal agent inside the Qwen (千问) app; invite test opened ~2026-10-13; cloud computer; Taobao/Fliggy/Alipay/Amap ecosystem. Seed record is a widely reported tester case.

name: Tencent LightVela
notes: Tencent's cloud-hosted Hermes-based personal agent with a free one-month trial. No first-hand use found in seed run.

name: Tencent WorkBuddy
notes: Tencent work agent. No first-hand use found in seed run.

name: Kimi Work
notes: Moonshot's agent products. Seed run found only general complaints, no concrete use.

name: Doubao Agent
search_terms: 豆包 智能体 帮我
notes: ByteDance's Muse-style personal agent reported as in development; Doubao screen-reading agent blocked by many apps. No concrete use found.

name: Fo
notes: Personal agent that places phone calls; seed record is #Sponsored. Vendor inferred from @wajo_ai mention.

name: Quest
notes: Personal agent launched ~2026-11-06 by @VNallatamby; builds 100+ wiki files on the user from day one, own Android phone, custom iOS mini-apps; believers-only access. No use-case records yet.

name: OpenBot
notes: Self-hosted 'one workspace for your team and AI coworkers' (founder Norbert Bodziony); free for personal use, works with any model/subscription; desktop + iOS apps; many users migrating from Grok Bot.

name: MausBot
notes: Open-source, local-first Grok Bot alternative (Apache 2.0) with desktop and phone apps; bring your own agent/model logins.

name: Perplexity Teammates
notes: Always-on Perplexity agents that own ongoing jobs (announced ~2026-11-04); research preview on Max ($200/mo), web only. No first-hand use found yet.

name: Rerun
notes: Self-hostable business/open-source Grok Bot alternative ('AI coworkers'). No first-hand use found yet.

name: Nod
notes: Free, open-source (Apache 2.0) personal agent from n8n Labs, research preview launched ~2026-11-10 for macOS/Windows; runs in a local sandbox VM with its own browser, uses your own AI provider, asks before acting (e.g. cancels subscriptions, watches prices). No first-hand use found yet.

name: Pots
notes: Open-source Grok Bot alternative launched ~2026-11-11 by @Crokily_: an AI coworker living in Slack/Discord/Telegram that reads channels and works on its own computer, any model/subscription. No first-hand use found yet.

name: Tab
notes: SMS/iMessage personal agent that users list alongside Hark, Instinct, Muse and Dot (e.g. a user's Instinct and Tab email each other). Vendor/official handle not yet verified. No first-hand use record yet.
